{"response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"UtaKad3kNuWez7IPq4nO6AU","candidates":[{"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Stable mode uses reluctant doubling strategy\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Focused mode: Glue-Protected Trend Restarting\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve or calculate two Exponential Moving Averages (EMA) of LBD\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Compute the trend ratio R = Fast_EMA / Slow_EMA\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow \u003e 0.0)\n    R = fast / slow;\n\n  // Step 3: Determine a dynamic multiplier M\n  double M = 1.0;\n  if (R \u003c 0.85)\n    M = 1.4; // Search quality improving, extend the run\n  else if (R \u003e 1.15)\n    M = 0.7; // Search quality degrading, curtail the run\n\n  // Step 4: Retrieve the solver's scheduled restart conflict limit\n  const uint64_t limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  // Step 5: Check if the current conflict count exceeds the scheduled limit multiplied by M\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003e limit * M) {\n    // Secondary 'Glue Check': if the most recently learned clause has an LBD \u003c= 2, suppress restart.\n    // Since the API does not expose the last learned clause's LBD directly, \n    // we use the fast_glue EMA as a robust proxy for recent clause quality.\n    if (fast \u003c= 2.0)\n      return false;\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]}}],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5880,"modality":"TEXT"}],"candidatesTokenCount":438,"promptTokenCount":5880,"totalTokenCount":17791,"thoughtsTokenCount":11473}},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
